_why: A pre-commit gate only ever sees ADDED lines, so it is structurally blind to what is already in the tree. The only thing that finds an OLD secret is a full re-scan, and the moment a full re-scan pays is when the detector improves — on 2026-08-17 a word-boundary fix made every SCREAMING_SNAKE secret visible for the first time, including two passwords that had sat at the public tip. A weekly cadence would have sat on them for up to six more days. So this file pins the detector to the last full scan run with it: change src/scripts/secret_scan.py and test_secret_scan.py goes red until somebody re-scans and records the result here.
_how_to_clear_the_red: python3 src/scripts/secret_scan.py ref origin/main   # and history, if the question is the whole repo
triage the output — masked; a raw candidate count is not a finding
update every field below, including distinct_values and real_findings
record the triage on the sweep row, not only here
